definitions.explanation: The percentage charged for borrowing money or paid for depositing money.

examples.japanese: {金利|きんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{低|てい}→低：03961_tei⟧{金利|きんり}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The era of low interest rates continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金利|きんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{金利|きんり} refers to interest rates in banking and finance. It covers both the rate charged on loans and the rate earned on deposits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金利|きんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧/⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to raise/lower interest rates
- {金利|きんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: interest rates rise/fall
- ⟦{低|てい}→低：03961_tei⟧{金利|きんり}: low interest rate
- ⟦{高|こう}→高：03951_kou⟧{金利|きんり}: high interest rate
- ⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧{金利|きんり}: variable interest rate
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧{金利|きんり}: fixed interest rate

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧: interest (the actual money paid/earned)
- ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧: interest rate (synonym, slightly more technical)
- ⟦{年利|ねんり}→年利：28649_nenri⟧: annual interest rate

NOTE:
{金利|きんり} often appears in news about ⟦{日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}→日本銀行：10141_nipponginkou⟧ (Bank of Japan) monetary policy decisions.
